cond_0001.intro:
As an Engineering and Maintenance Director, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of our food manufacturing facilities. Your responsibilities will cover overseeing engineering projects, managing maintenance teams, and maintaining compliance with safety and quality standards.
You will lead the Plant in developing processes to produce food products more efficiently. This role will require a strong end-to-end food manufacturing process background. Success will be measured through improved performance in Food Safety, Quality, and productivity. This role will own target setting and target adjustments of KPIs including Direct Labor, Yield, Throughput, and Pounds per Direct Labor Hour. Target setting will be data-based through using tools such as [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]. Skill sets such as Lean, 6-Sigma, Continuous Improvement, TQM, and Change Management will be key to the success of this role. This role will work closely with the Plant Director to set up teams to drive improved performance with a target of 2 productivity projects per quarter. The role includes significant time on the Plant Floor. This role will also partner with Engineering to support OEM Design Capacity and work area layout for ease of production, cleaning, and maintenance.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Leadership and Strategy:
Develop and execute a long-term vision for engineering and maintenance operations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align engineering efforts with overall business goals.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and reduce downtime.
Maintenance Management:
Directly manage maintenance associates and leads through performance management.
Oversee preventative maintenance compliance and effectiveness.
Ensure timely repairs and maintenance of equipment, machinery, and facilities.
Develop and implement maintenance schedules and procedures.
Engineering Projects:
Lead engineering projects related to process optimization, equipment upgrades, and facility expansion.
Collaborate with design teams to ensure seamless project execution.
Monitor project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.
Safety and Compliance:
Maintain compliance with safety regulations, environmental standards, and quality requirements.
Implement best practices for safe work practices and risk mitigation.
Conduct regular safety audits and address any non-compliance issues promptly.
Budgeting and Cost Control:
Develop and manage the engineering and maintenance budget.
Optimize costs while ensuring high-quality maintenance services.
Evaluate capital expenditure requests and prioritize projects.
Vendor Management:
Liaise with external vendors and contractors for maintenance services and equipment procurement.
Negotiate contracts, monitor performance, and ensure timely delivery of services.
Training and Development:
Provide technical training to maintenance teams.
Mentor and coach team members to enhance their skills and knowledge.
Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
Emergency Response:
Develop and implement emergency response plans for equipment failures, power outages, and other critical incidents.
Coordinate with relevant teams to minimize production disruptions.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Industrial Engineering.
Minimum 8-10 years of experience in maintenance and engineering in the food manufacturing industry.
Knowledgeable in ISO, USDA, and food customer-regulated environments.
Strong mathematical and analytical skills.
Preferred Requirements:
Strong leadership skills, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Knowledge of regulatory requirements, safety protocols, and industry best practices.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

In this role, you will oversee engineering and maintenance operations across food manufacturing facilities, with responsibility for safety, quality, and productivity outcomes. The role requires a strong end-to-end food manufacturing process background. Performance will be measured through Food Safety, Quality, and productivity metrics. You will own KPI target setting and adjustments — including Direct Labor, Yield, Throughput, and Pounds per Direct Labor Hour — using tools such as [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]. Relevant skill sets include Lean, 6-Sigma, Continuous Improvement, TQM, and Change Management. You will work with the Plant Director to structure teams toward improved performance, with a target of 2 productivity projects per quarter. The role includes significant time on the plant floor and involves supporting OEM Design Capacity and work area layout in coordination with Engineering. Will require 50% travel.
cond_0061.responsibilities:
Leadership and Strategy:
Develop and execute a long-term vision for engineering and maintenance operations.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to align engineering efforts with overall business goals.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and reduce downtime.
Maintenance Management:
Directly manage maintenance associates and leads through performance management.
Oversee preventative maintenance compliance and effectiveness.
Ensure timely repairs and maintenance of equipment, machinery, and facilities.
Develop and implement maintenance schedules and procedures.
Engineering Projects:
Lead engineering projects related to process optimization, equipment upgrades, and facility expansion.
Coordinate with design teams to support seamless project execution.
Monitor project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.
Safety and Compliance:
Maintain compliance with safety regulations, environmental standards, and quality requirements.
Implement best practices for safe work practices and risk mitigation.
Conduct safety audits and address non-compliance issues promptly.
Budgeting and Cost Control:
Develop and manage the engineering and maintenance budget.
Optimize costs while ensuring high-quality maintenance services.
Evaluate capital expenditure requests and prioritize projects.
Vendor Management:
Coordinate with external vendors and contractors for maintenance services and equipment procurement.
Negotiate contracts, monitor performance, and ensure timely delivery of services.
Training and Development:
Provide technical training to maintenance teams.
Mentor and coach team members to build their skills and knowledge.
Support a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
Emergency Response:
Develop and implement emergency response plans for equipment failures, power outages, and other critical incidents.
Coordinate with relevant teams to minimize production disruptions.
cond_0061.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Industrial Engineering.
Minimum 8-10 years of experience in maintenance and engineering in the food manufacturing industry.
Knowledge of ISO, USDA, and food customer-regulated environments.
Strong mathematical and analytical skills.
Knowledge of regulatory requirements, safety protocols, and industry best practices.
Preferred Requirements:
Strong leadership skills, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting skills.

You will lead the Plant in developing processes to produce food products more efficiently. This role will require a strong end-to-end food manufacturing process background. Success will be measured through improved performance in Food Safety, Quality, and productivity. This role will own target setting and target adjustments of KPIs including Direct Labor, Yield, Throughput, and Pounds per Direct Labor Hour. Target setting will be data-based through using tools such as [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]. Skill sets such as Lean, 6-Sigma, Continuous Improvement, TQM, and Change Management will be key to the success of this role. This role will work closely with the Plant Director to set up teams to drive improved performance with a target of 2 productivity projects per quarter. The role includes significant time on the Plant Floor. This role will also partner with Engineering to support OEM Design Capacity and work area layout for ease of production, cleaning, and maintenance.
cond_0199.responsibilities:
Leadership and Strategy:
Develop and execute a long-term vision for engineering and maintenance operations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align engineering efforts with overall business goals.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and reduce downtime.
Maintenance Management:
Directly manage maintenance associates and leads through performance management.
Oversee preventative maintenance compliance and effectiveness.
Ensure timely repairs and maintenance of equipment, machinery, and facilities.
Develop and implement maintenance schedules and procedures.
Engineering Projects:
Lead engineering projects related to process optimization, equipment upgrades, and facility expansion.
Collaborate with design teams to ensure seamless project execution.
Monitor project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.
Safety and Compliance:
Maintain compliance with safety regulations, environmental standards, and quality requirements.
Implement best practices for safe work practices and risk mitigation.
Conduct regular safety audits and address any non-compliance issues promptly.
Budgeting and Cost Control:
Develop and manage the engineering and maintenance budget.
Optimize costs while ensuring high-quality maintenance services.
Evaluate capital expenditure requests and prioritize projects.
Vendor Management:
Liaise with external vendors and contractors for maintenance services and equipment procurement.
Negotiate contracts, monitor performance, and ensure timely delivery of services.
Training and Development:
Provide technical training to maintenance teams.
Mentor and coach team members to enhance their skills and knowledge.
Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
Emergency Response:
Develop and implement emergency response plans for equipment failures, power outages, and other critical incidents.
Coordinate with relevant teams to minimize production disruptions.
cond_0199.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Industrial Engineering.
Minimum 8-10 years of experience in maintenance and engineering in the food manufacturing industry.
Knowledgeable in ISO, USDA, and food customer-regulated environments.
Strong mathematical and analytical skills.
Preferred Requirements:
Strong leadership skills, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Knowledge of regulatory requirements, safety protocols, and industry best practices.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
cond_0199.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.

cond_0262.intro:
We are looking for a Director of Engineering and Maintenance to join our team.
You will lead the Plant in developing processes to produce food products more efficiently. This role will be required to have a strong end-to-end food manufacturing process background. The success of this role will be measured through improved performance in Food Safety, Quality, and productivity. This role will own target setting and target adjustments of KPIs including Direct Labor, Yield, Throughput, and Pounds per Direct Labor Hour. Target setting will be data-based through using tools such as [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]. Skill sets such as Lean, 6-Sigma, Continuous Improvement, TQM, and Change Management will be key to the success of this role. This role will work closely with the Plant Director to set up teams to drive improved performance with a target of 2 productivity projects per quarter. The role includes significant time on the Plant Floor. This role will also partner with Engineering to support OEM Design Capacity and work area layout for ease of production, cleaning, and maintenance.
cond_0262.responsibilities:
Leadership and Strategy:
Develop and execute a long-term vision for engineering and maintenance operations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align engineering efforts with overall business goals.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and reduce downtime.
Maintenance Management:
Directly manage maintenance associates and leads through performance management.
Oversee preventative maintenance compliance and effectiveness.
Ensure timely repairs and maintenance of equipment, machinery, and facilities.
Develop and implement maintenance schedules and procedures.
Engineering Projects:
Lead engineering projects related to process optimization, equipment upgrades, and facility expansion.
Collaborate with design teams to ensure seamless project execution.
Monitor project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.
Safety and Compliance:
Maintain compliance with safety regulations, environmental standards, and quality requirements.
Implement best practices for safe work practices and risk mitigation.
Conduct regular safety audits and address any non-compliance issues promptly.
Budgeting and Cost Control:
Develop and manage the engineering and maintenance budget.
Optimize costs while ensuring high-quality maintenance services.
Evaluate capital expenditure requests and prioritize projects.
Vendor Management:
Liaise with external vendors and contractors for maintenance services and equipment procurement.
Negotiate contracts, monitor performance, and ensure timely delivery of services.
Training and Development:
Provide technical training to maintenance teams.
Mentor and coach team members to enhance their skills and knowledge.
Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
Emergency Response:
Develop and implement emergency response plans for equipment failures, power outages, and other critical incidents.
Coordinate with relevant teams to minimize production disruptions.
cond_0262.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Industrial Engineering.
Knowledgeable in ISO, USDA, and food customer-regulated environments.
Minimum 8-10 years of experience in maintenance and engineering in the food manufacturing industry.
Strong mathematical and analytical skills.
Strong leadership skills, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Knowledge of regulatory requirements, safety protocols, and industry best practices.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

cond_0346.intro:

Success will be measured through improved performance in Food Safety, Quality, and productivity. This role will own target setting and target adjustments of KPIs including Direct Labor, Yield, Throughput, and Pounds per Direct Labor Hour. This role will work closely with the Plant Director to set up teams to drive improved performance with a target of 2 productivity projects per quarter. The role includes significant time on the Plant Floor. This role will also partner with Engineering to support OEM Design Capacity and work area layout for ease of production, cleaning, and maintenance. You will lead the Plant in developing processes to produce food products more efficiently. This role will be required to have a strong end-to-end food manufacturing process background. The success of this role will be measured through improved performance in Food Safety, Quality, and productivity. This role will own target setting and target adjustments of KPIs including Direct Labor, Yield, Throughput, and Pounds per Direct Labor Hour. Target setting will be data-based through using tools such as [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]. Skill sets such as Lean, 6-Sigma, Continuous Improvement, TQM, and Change Management will be key to the success of this role. This role will work closely with the Plant Director to set up teams to drive improved performance with a target of 2 productivity projects per quarter. The role includes significant time on the Plant Floor. This role will also partner with Engineering to support OEM Design Capacity and work area layout for ease of production, cleaning, and maintenance. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with food manufacturing engineering and maintenance work.
cond_0428.responsibilities:
Leadership and Strategy:
Develop and execute a long-term vision for engineering and maintenance operations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align engineering efforts with overall business goals.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and reduce downtime.
Maintenance Management:
Directly manage maintenance associates and leads through performance management.
Oversee preventative maintenance compliance and effectiveness.
Ensure timely repairs and maintenance of equipment, machinery, and facilities.
Develop and implement maintenance schedules and procedures.
Engineering Projects:
Lead engineering projects related to process optimization, equipment upgrades, and facility expansion.
Collaborate with design teams to ensure seamless project execution.
Monitor project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.
Safety and Compliance:
Maintain compliance with safety regulations, environmental standards, and quality requirements.
Implement best practices for safe work practices and risk mitigation.
Conduct regular safety audits and address any non-compliance issues promptly.
Budgeting and Cost Control:
Develop and manage the engineering and maintenance budget.
Optimize costs while ensuring high-quality maintenance services.
Evaluate capital expenditure requests and prioritize projects.
Vendor Management:
Liaise with external vendors and contractors for maintenance services and equipment procurement.
Negotiate contracts, monitor performance, and ensure timely delivery of services.
Training and Development:
Provide technical training to maintenance teams.
Mentor and coach team members to enhance their skills and knowledge.
Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
Emergency Response:
Develop and implement emergency response plans for equipment failures, power outages, and other critical incidents.
Coordinate with relevant teams to minimize production disruptions.
cond_0428.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Industrial Engineering.
Knowledgeable in ISO, USDA, and food customer-regulated environments.
Minimum 8-10 years of experience in maintenance and engineering in the food manufacturing industry.
Strong mathematical and analytical skills.
Strong leadership skills, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Knowledge of regulatory requirements, safety protocols, and industry best practices.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
cond_0428.values: We value excellence in execution and a clear focus on results. We aim to produce work that reflects high standards and a strong commitment to performance.

cond_0464.intro:
As an Engineering and Maintenance Director, you will oversee engineering projects, manage maintenance teams, and maintain compliance with safety and quality standards in food manufacturing facilities.
You will lead the Plant in developing processes to produce food products more efficiently. This role will be required to have a strong end-to-end food manufacturing process background. The success of this role will be measured through improved performance in Food Safety, Quality, and productivity. This role will own target setting and target adjustments of KPIs including Direct Labor, Yield, Throughput, and Pounds per Direct Labor Hour. Target setting will be data-based through using tools such as [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]. Skill sets such as Lean, 6-Sigma, Continuous Improvement, TQM, and Change Management will be key to the success of this role. This role will work closely with the Plant Director to set up teams to drive improved performance with a target of 2 productivity projects per quarter. The role includes significant time on the Plant Floor. This role will also partner with Engineering to support OEM Design Capacity and work area layout for ease of production, cleaning, and maintenance. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with food manufacturing engineering and maintenance work.

Develop and execute a long-term vision for engineering and maintenance operations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align engineering efforts with overall business goals.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and reduce downtime.
Maintenance Management:
Directly manage maintenance associates and leads through performance management.
Oversee preventative maintenance compliance and effectiveness.
Ensure timely repairs and maintenance of equipment, machinery, and facilities.
Develop and implement maintenance schedules and procedures.
Engineering Projects:
Lead engineering projects related to process optimization, equipment upgrades, and facility expansion.
Collaborate with design teams to ensure seamless project execution.
Monitor project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.
Safety and Compliance:
Maintain compliance with safety regulations, environmental standards, and quality requirements.
Implement best practices for safe work practices and risk mitigation.
Conduct regular safety audits and address any non-compliance issues promptly.
Budgeting and Cost Control:
Develop and manage the engineering and maintenance budget.
Optimize costs while ensuring high-quality maintenance services.
Evaluate capital expenditure requests and prioritize projects.
Vendor Management:
Liaise with external vendors and contractors for maintenance services and equipment procurement.
Negotiate contracts, monitor performance, and ensure timely delivery of services.
Training and Development:
Provide technical training to maintenance teams.
Mentor and coach team members to enhance their skills and knowledge.
Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
Emergency Response:
Develop and implement emergency response plans for equipment failures, power outages, and other critical incidents.
Coordinate with relevant teams to minimize production disruptions.

Knowledgeable in ISO, USDA, and food customer-regulated environments.
Minimum 8-10 years of experience in maintenance and engineering in the food manufacturing industry.

We are looking for a Director of Engineering and Maintenance to join our team at [Company name masked] in [Location masked].
As an Engineering and Maintenance Director, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of our food manufacturing facilities. Your responsibilities will encompass overseeing engineering projects, managing maintenance teams, and maintaining compliance with safety and quality standards.
You will lead the Plant in developing processes to produce food products more efficiently. This role will be required to have a strong end-to-end food manufacturing process background. The success of this role will be measured through improved performance in Food Safety, Quality, and productivity. This role will own target setting and target adjustments of KPIs including Direct Labor, Yield, Throughput, and Pounds per Direct Labor Hour. Target setting will be data-based through using tools such as [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]. Skill sets such as Lean, 6-Sigma, Continuous Improvement, TQM, and Change Management will be key to the success of this role. This role will work closely with the Plant Director to set up teams to drive improved performance with a target of 2 productivity projects per quarter. The role includes significant time on the Plant Floor. This role will also partner with Engineering to support OEM Design Capacity and work area layout for ease of production, cleaning, and maintenance. People tend to become stronger in this kind of manufacturing leadership work over time as they build experience and learn from the results they see on the floor.

Implement best practices for safe work practices and risk mitigation.

Budgeting and Cost Control:
Develop and manage the engineering and maintenance budget.
Optimize costs while ensuring high-quality maintenance services.
Evaluate capital expenditure requests and prioritize projects.
Vendor Management:

Negotiate contracts, monitor performance, and ensure timely delivery of services.
Training and Development:

Mentor and coach team members to enhance their skills and knowledge.
Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development.

Develop and implement emergency response plans for equipment failures, power outages, and other critical incidents.
Coordinate with relevant teams to minimize production disruptions.

You will lead the Plant in developing processes to produce food products more efficiently. This role will be required to have a strong end-to-end food manufacturing process background. This role will own target setting and target adjustments of KPIs including Direct Labor, Yield, Throughput, and Pounds per Direct Labor Hour. Negotiate contracts, monitor performance, and ensure timely delivery of services.

You will lead the Plant in developing processes to produce food products more efficiently. This role will require a strong end-to-end food manufacturing process background. Success will be measured through improved performance in Food Safety, Quality, and productivity. This role will own target setting and target adjustments of KPIs including Direct Labor, Yield, Throughput, and Pounds per Direct Labor Hour. Target setting will be data-based through using tools such as [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]. Skill sets such as Lean, 6-Sigma, Continuous Improvement, TQM, and Change Management will be key to the success of this role. This role will work closely with the Plant Director to set up teams to drive improved performance with a target of 2 productivity projects per quarter. The role includes significant time on the Plant Floor. This role will also partner with Engineering to support OEM Design Capacity and work area layout for ease of production, cleaning, and maintenance.
cond_0595.responsibilities:
Leadership and Strategy:
Develop and execute a long-term vision for engineering and maintenance operations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align engineering efforts with overall business goals.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and reduce downtime.
Maintenance Management:
Directly manage maintenance associates and leads through performance management.
Oversee preventative maintenance compliance and effectiveness.
Ensure timely repairs and maintenance of equipment, machinery, and facilities.
Develop and implement maintenance schedules and procedures.
Engineering Projects:
Lead engineering projects related to process optimization, equipment upgrades, and facility expansion.
Collaborate with design teams to ensure seamless project execution.
Monitor project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.
Safety and Compliance:
Maintain compliance with safety regulations, environmental standards, and quality requirements.
Implement best practices for safe work practices and risk mitigation.
Conduct regular safety audits and address any non-compliance issues promptly.
Budgeting and Cost Control:
Develop and manage the engineering and maintenance budget.
Optimize costs while ensuring high-quality maintenance services.
Evaluate capital expenditure requests and prioritize projects.
Vendor Management:
Liaise with external vendors and contractors for maintenance services and equipment procurement.
Negotiate contracts, monitor performance, and ensure timely delivery of services.
Training and Development:
Provide technical training to maintenance teams.
Mentor and coach team members to enhance their skills and knowledge.
Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
Emergency Response:
Develop and implement emergency response plans for equipment failures, power outages, and other critical incidents.
Coordinate with relevant teams to minimize production disruptions.
cond_0595.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Industrial Engineering.
Minimum 8-10 years of experience in maintenance and engineering in the food manufacturing industry.
Knowledgeable in ISO, USDA, and food customer-regulated environments.
Strong mathematical and analytical skills.
Preferred Requirements:
Strong leadership skills, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Knowledge of regulatory requirements, safety protocols, and industry best practices.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
